# 游戏开发技能

帮助开发HTML5小游戏的专家技能，专注于麻将、扑克、棋牌等类型的浏览器游戏。

## 快速开始

1. 确认游戏类型和核心玩法
2. 选择技术方案（纯前端/局域网联机/服务器版）
3. 开始实现游戏逻辑

## 游戏类型

### 棋牌游戏
- **麻将**：桐城自摸、血战到底、四川麻将等
- **扑克**：掼蛋、斗地主、德州扑克、炸金花等
- **其他**：象棋、围棋、五子棋等

### 技术方案

| 方案 | 适用场景 | 技术栈 |
|------|----------|--------|
| 纯前端 | 单机游戏、本地多人 | HTML + CSS + JS |
| 局域网联机 | 家庭/办公室多人 | WebSocket + Node.js |
| 服务器版 | 互联网多人 | Socket.io + 数据库 |

## 开发流程

### 步骤 1：需求分析
- 确定游戏规则和特殊玩法
- 确定玩家数量和交互方式
- 确定是否需要AI对手

### 步骤 2：界面设计
- 游戏桌面布局
- 卡牌/麻将牌样式
- 玩家位置和交互按钮
- 动画效果

### 步骤 3：核心逻辑
- 游戏状态管理
- 牌型判断算法
- 回合流程控制
- 胜负判定

### 步骤 4：网络功能（如需要）
- WebSocket 通信
- 房间管理
- 玩家状态同步
- 断线重连处理

## 代码规范

### 文件组织
```
game-name/
├── index.html        # 主页面
├── game.js          # 游戏逻辑
├── server.js        # 服务器（如需要）
├── styles.css       # 样式（可内联）
└── README.md        # 使用说明
```

### 命名约定
- 函数：驼峰命名 `calculateScore()`
- 常量：大写下划线 `MAX_PLAYERS`
- CSS类：短横线命名 `.player-hand`

### 样式风格
- 使用渐变背景营造游戏氛围
- 金色/绿色主题适合棋牌游戏
- 按钮要有明显的悬停和点击效果

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>

    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a472a 0%, #2d5a3d 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* 大厅样式 - 登录界面 */
        #loginScreen {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(13, 40, 24, 0.98);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 200;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        #loginScreen h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #ffd700;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            animation: glow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;

        @keyframes glow {
            from { text-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd700, 0 0 20px #ffd700; }
            to { text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700, 0 0 40px #ffd700, 0 0 60px #ff8c00; }
        }

        #loginScreen .subtitle {
            color: #90ee90;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .name-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;

            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .name-bar label {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .name-bar input {
            width: 200px;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 2px solid #ffd700;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .name-bar input:focus {
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffd700;
        }

        .name-bar input::placeholder {
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表容器 */
        .lobby-container {
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding: 0 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header h2 {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: #4CAF50;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: #45a049;
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: #f44336;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #607D8B;
            color: white;
        }

        .table-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .table-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .table-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .table-card.empty {
            border-color: #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-card.waiting {
            border-color: #FFC107;
        }

        .table-card.playing {
            border-color: #2196F3;
        }

        .table-card.full {
            border-color: #f44336;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .table-card.new-table {
            background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3);
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-number {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .table-status {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .table-players {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 0.8em;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表中的小型圆桌布局 */
        .mini-table-layout {
            position: relative;
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            margin: 10px auto;
        }

        .mini-table-center {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a3d2a 100%);
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .mini-seat {
            position: absolute;
            text-align: center;
            width: 32px;
        }

        /* 逆时针顺序: 1(底) → 2(右) → 3(顶) → 4(左) */
        .mini-seat-1 { bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-2 { right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-3 { top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-4 { left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }

        .mini-seat-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: 2px solid #555;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar.occupied {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4CAF50, #2E7D32);
            border-color: #81C784;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar:hover:not(.occupied) {
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            border-color: #FFD700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .table-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 5px;
        }

        .table-id {
            color: #FFD700;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .table-mode-badge {
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2);
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        .table-footer {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #ccc;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .table-footer.full {
            color: #ff6b6b;
        }

        .table-footer.playing {
            color: #4dabf7;
        }

        .deck-info {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #90ee90;
            margin-top: 5px;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* 创建新桌卡片样式 */
        .create-table-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.3));
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 200px;
        }

        .create-table-card .plus {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #4CAF50;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .create-table-card .text {
            color: #4CAF50;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .create-table-card:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.5), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.5));
        }

        /* 游戏界面样式 */
        .game-container {
            display: none;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            position: relative;
        }

        .game-table {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a472a 100%);
        }

        /* 玩家区域 */
        .player-area {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .player-area.bottom {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 80%;
        }

        .player-area.top {
            top: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.left {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.right {
            right: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-info {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            padding: 8px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .player-info.active {
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FFD700;
        }

        .player-name {
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .hand-count {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        /* 展示区 */
        .showed-area {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
            margin: 5px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .showed-card {
            width: 30px;
            height: 40px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #333;
        }

        .showed-card.fa {
            background: #FFD700;
        }

        .showed-card.gang {
            background: #90EE90;
        }

        /* 手牌区域 */
        .hand-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1px;
            padding: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a472a 0%, #0d2818 100%);
            border-radius: 10px;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 图片中的真实样式 */
        .card {
            width: 34px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #e8e8e0 50%, #ddd8d0 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 2px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 3px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 4px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 5px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 1px solid #d8d0c8;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,

                0 7px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 9px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
            z-index: 10;

        .card.selected {

            z-index: 20;

        .card.dragging {
            opacity: 0.6;

        .card.drag-over {
            border-left: 3px solid #FFD700;

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .card.wild {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 50%, #ffe082 100%);
            border: 2px solid #ffa000;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #ff8f00,
                0 2px 0 #f57c00,
                0 3px 0 #ef6c00,
                0 4px 0 #e65100,
                0 5px 3px rgba(255,152,0,0.4),
                0 0 10px rgba(255,160,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .card.wild::before {
            content: '癞';

            top: -2px;
            right: -2px;

            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5722 0%, #e64a19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* 牌面内容容器 */
        .card-face {
            width: 28px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #fafaf5;
            border-radius: 2px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            border: 1px solid #e8e0d8;
        }

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;
        }

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 24px;
            height: 32px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #90caf9, #1976d2 70%, #0d47a1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆带花边 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #64b5f6, #1976d2 60%, #0d47a1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;

        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .card.tong.p7 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }

        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 8px; height: 8px; }

        /* 8筒 */
        .card.tong.p8 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: none; }

        .card.tong.p9 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .card.tong.p9 .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; }

        /* 条子牌 - 竹节图案 */

        }

            align-items: center;
        }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-stick {
            width: 4px;
            height: 6px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2e7d32, #4caf50 40%, #66bb6a 50%, #4caf50 60%, #2e7d32);
            border-radius: 1px;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        /* 万子牌 */
        .card.wan .card-face {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0px;
        }
        .card.wan .wan-num {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #c62828;
            line-height: 1;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
        }
        .card.wan .wan-char {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #c62828;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
        }

        /* 风牌 */
        .card.feng .card-face {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.feng .feng-char {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #1565c0;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }

        /* 箭牌 */
        .card.jian .card-face {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.jian .jian-char {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
        }

            color: #c62828;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }
        .card.jian.fa .jian-char {
            color: #2e7d32;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }
        .card.jian.bai .jian-char {
            color: #455a64;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #78909c, -1px -1px 0 #fff;
        }

        /* 兼容旧样式（用于其他区域显示） */
        .card-rank {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .card-suit {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 中央信息区 */
        .center-info {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .wild-card-info {
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .wild-card-info .label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .wild-card-info .card-display {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        .deck-count {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .game-time {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #FFD700;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* 操作按钮 */
        .action-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 10px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            font-size: 14px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;

            background: #FFD700;
            color: #333;
        }

            background: #9C27B0;

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }
        }

        // 退出
        function logout() {
            if (currentTableId) {
                leaveTable();
            }
            playerId = null;
            playerName = '';
        }

        // 渲染牌桌列表
        function renderTableList(tables) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tableList');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建新桌卡片
            const createCard = document.createElement('div');
            createCard.className = 'table-card create-table-card';
            createCard.innerHTML = `
                <div class="plus">+</div>
                <div class="text">开房</div>
            `;
            createCard.onclick = createTable;
            container.appendChild(createCard);

            // 现有牌桌
            tables.forEach((table, index) => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                const isFull = table.playerCount >= 4;
                const isPlaying = table.started;

                card.className = `table-card ${isFull ? 'full' : ''} ${isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}`;

                // 生成圆桌座位显示
                let seatsHtml = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const seatNum = i + 1;
                    const player = table.players.find(p => p.seatNum === seatNum);
                    const occupied = !!player;
                    const occupiedClass = occupied ? 'occupied' : '';
                    const clickHandler = (!occupied && !isPlaying) ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); joinTableById('${table.id}', ${seatNum})"` : '';
                    const title = occupied && player ? player.name : (isPlaying ? '' : '点击加入');
                    const displayChar = occupied ? (player ? player.name.charAt(0) : '?') : '+';

                    seatsHtml += `
                        <div class="mini-seat mini-seat-${seatNum}">
                            <div class="mini-seat-avatar ${occupiedClass}" ${clickHandler} title="${title}">
                                ${displayChar}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // 状态文字
                let statusText = `${table.playerCount}/4 人`;
                let statusClass = '';
                let deckInfo = '';
                if (isPlaying) {
                    const deckCount = table.deckCount !== undefined ? table.deckCount : '?';
                    deckInfo = `<div class="deck-info">剩余: ${deckCount}张</div>`;
                    statusText = '🀄 游戏中';
                    statusClass = 'playing';
                } else if (isFull) {
                    statusText = '已满员';
                    statusClass = 'full';
                }

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="table-header">
                        <div class="table-id">牌桌：${table.tableNumber}</div>
                        <div class="table-mode-badge">${isPlaying ? '游戏中' : '等待中'}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>
                        ${seatsHtml}
                    </div>
                    <div class="table-footer ${statusClass}">${statusText}</div>
                    ${deckInfo}
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // 通过ID加入牌桌
        function joinTableById(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            joinTable(tableId, seatNum);
        }

        // 创建牌桌
        function createTable() {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            }
        }

        // 加入牌桌
        function joinTable(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            }
        }

        // 离开牌桌
        function leaveTable() {
            showLobby();
            currentTableId = null;
            isReady = false;
        }

        // 显示大厅
        function showLobby() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'none';
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            }
        }

        // 显示游戏界面
        function showGame() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'block';
        }

        // 渲染玩家列表
        function renderPlayerList(data) {
            showGame();

            document.getElementById('tableNumDisplay').textContent = data.tableNumber;

            // 更新准备面板
            const seatList = document.getElementById('seatList');
            seatList.innerHTML = '';

            const players = data.players || [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
                const player = players.find(p => p.seatNum === i);
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'seat-item';

                if (player) {
                    div.classList.add('occupied');
                    if (player.id === playerId) {
                        div.classList.add('me');
                    }
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>${player.name} ${player.ready ? '✓已准备' : ''}</div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>空位</div>
                    `;
                }
                seatList.appendChild(div);
            }

            // 游戏已开始，隐藏准备面板
            if (data.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
            } else {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            // 更新准备按钮
            const myPlayer = players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
            isReady = myPlayer ? myPlayer.ready : false;
            document.getElementById('readyBtn').textContent = isReady ? '取消准备' : '准备';
        }

        // 切换准备状态
        function toggleReady() {
            isReady = !isReady;
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ready', ready: isReady }));
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

        // 更新游戏UI
        function updateGameUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;

            // 游戏开始后隐藏准备面板和发牌动画
            if (gameState.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            // 更新万能牌
            if (gameState.wildCard) {
                document.getElementById('wildCardDisplay').textContent =
                    getCardDisplayName(gameState.wildCard);
            }

            // 更新牌堆数量
            document.getElementById('deckCount').textContent = gameState.deckCount;

            // 更新游戏时间
            if (gameState.totalGameTime !== undefined) {
                const minutes = Math.floor(gameState.totalGameTime / 60);
                const seconds = gameState.totalGameTime % 60;
                document.getElementById('gameTime').textContent =
                    `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }

            // 更新各玩家信息
            // 先找到自己的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right, 2=top, 3=left
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 计算相对位置
                let relativePos = (seatNum - mySeatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right), 2->3(top), 3->4(left)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                    if (info.seatNum === seatNum) {
                        foundPlayer = info;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const nameEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Name`);
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);
                const infoEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Info`);
                const showedEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Showed`);

                if (!nameEl || !countEl || !infoEl || !showedEl) {
                    console.error('找不到元素:', posName);
                    continue;
                }

                if (foundPlayer) {
                    nameEl.textContent = foundPlayer.name;
                    countEl.textContent = foundPlayer.handCount;

                    // 高亮当前玩家
                    if (gameState.currentPlayerSeat === seatNum) {
                        infoEl.classList.add('active');
                        nameEl.classList.add('current-turn');
                    } else {
                        infoEl.classList.remove('active');
                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');
                    }

                    // 展示区
                    showedEl.innerHTML = '';

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {
                        foundPlayer.showedCards.fa.forEach(card => {
                            const div = document.createElement('div');
                            div.className = 'showed-card fa';
                            div.textContent = '發';
                            showedEl.appendChild(div);
                        });

                        foundPlayer.showedCards.gang.forEach(gang => {
                            gang.forEach(card => {
